dedupe_keys.name: dfes stations dfes 023 western australia verified locations of fire and emergency services stations and offices

description: This data set gives the verified locations of the fire and emergency services stations and offices across Western Australia, a state where bushfires, cyclones and floods cover very large, sparsely populated areas. It is published by the Department of Fire and Emergency Services (DFES) through the state's shared location information platform. Each point marks a DFES station or office, and coverage is the whole state. The layer is free and available to download as GeoPackage, GeoJSON, file geodatabase or shapefile, or to use through WFS, WMS and ArcGIS web services, under CC BY 4.0; its metadata were updated in September 2026. Caveats: the page read does not list the attribute fields, so crewing, appliances and volunteer or career status need checking in the files, and brigades run by local governments may not all be included. Simulation uses: modelling response times and coverage gaps for bushfire and cyclone response, locating stations exposed to hazards, and planning where new stations would reduce response times. Related records: the Scottish Fire and Rescue station register (data-sfrs-fire-stations-and-incident-statistics) and the US National Fire Department Registry (data-usfa-national-fire-department-registry) are comparable station inventories.
